messages:
emma-peopleops: Diego starts Wed. He's in MEX. Passport is the only ID he has right now. Need an I-9 remote plan + laptop shipping. Any quick policy notes?

raj-recruiter: Candidate can get a local notary but earliest is next week. He prefers we do a video verify so he can start earlier.

it-support-bot: Device queued: MacBook Air 13. Provision ETA 48h, shipping MEX ~4 business days.

emma-peopleops: Proposal: temporary remote I-9 exception: accept passport scan + recorded video verification now, require notarized original within 7bd. @security ok?

security: Fine as temporary exception with controls: recorded verification, secure upload of passport, exception ticket (SEC-2026-089). No access to sensitive systems until scanned docs attached.

diego-newhire: I can do video verify tomorrow 10:00 CST and will get a notary appointment for next Tue. Will upload passport now.

raj-recruiter: I'll send the template and expense code ONB-INTL for notary reimbursement.

emma-peopleops: Great. IT will hold full SSO until notarized doc arrives; we can provide limited Slack pre-boarding if security approves.

it-support-bot: Noted. Will send tracking when shipped and mark device as "hold until identity verified" in MDM.

emma-peopleops: Thanks all — creating exception ticket and scheduling the call. Will close thread after tracking + notarized doc received.
